meaning: Countermodels, from no premises: none of the eight act/potency premises of #352 follows from the other seven, even with sensible motion and no infinite per se series. This is independence from the tested premises only. It does not show that a derivation needs new vocabulary: further premises over the same predicates could suffice (for example, potency in r implies being moved in r, plus every mover is simply prior to what it moves, with the mover and act premises, entail act's simple priority). Any such added premise is a new open premise.
